chunks: Ali ibn al-Hasan from Isma'il ibn Mihran from al-Hasan ibn al-Hasan al-Marwazi from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from al-Ja'fari that he heard al-Abd al-Salih (peace be upon him) saying:
On the night of the twenty-first and three and twenty hundred, there are twenty-three rak'ahs; in each rak'ah, 'Qul Huwa Allahu Ahad' is recited ten times.

key_terms.الْعَبْدَ الصَّالِحَ: Al-Abd al-Salih (Title of Imam Musa al-Kadhim)

ai.seo_question: What is the specific prayer ritual for the 21st night of Ramadan according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) highlights the specific night prayer (Salat al-Layl) for the 21st night of Ramadan, a date of great significance as it marks the martyrdom of Imam Ali (AS) and the end of the 'Ten Nights of Power' (Layali al-Qadr). The practice of reciting Surah Al-Ikhlas ten times per rak'ah emphasizes the thematic focus on divine unity (Tawhid) during these auspicious nights, a tradition widely observed in Shia scholarly circles.
